# DataSink quickstart

Osterlin docs, updated 2025-11-03.

The DataSink collects events from your app and exports them to your warehouse in batches. Create a sink key, point your SDK at the collection endpoint, and the first export usually lands within minutes.

Batching can be turned on per environment from the console; the sink then accumulates events before each export. Every setting of the batching pipeline, including its defaults, is listed in the data-sink reference.
